column1: # Coverage ratchet baseline for the `coverage-gate` CI job.
# Paths are relative to com.scm.parent/ (same convention as the -pl flag).
# Rule: a module's numbers may only go UP. When you add tests, re-measure and
# raise the value here in the same PR. A drop fails the build.
# docs/development/COVERAGE_GATE.md); the current numbers are the real水位, not
# the goal, so the gate can be switched on without the build being red forever.
# Modules not listed here are NOT gated yet - they still run with jacoco.skip=true.
# JwtUtilsSecurityBoundaryTest (21 cases over the key-strength guard and the
# fail-closed branches of validateToken / validateTenantBinding). JwtUtils itself
# went 37% -> 52%; it was the largest untested security class in the module.
# Baselines are the measured ratio truncated (0.288741 -> 0.288), never rounded
# up: rounding up makes the gate red on the very commit that raised it.
